description: Check an economy spec: refusals (each with a code, what it means and its fix) stop it from going live; warnings are what the person must hear (chance that pays money, revenue paid to stakers, an unfunded prize, a grant without limits, a mint’s powers, a time far off with its date in words, a token a player can hold a payment up in, a box longer than one answer of the oracle’s holds). The program refuses only what it must: much of what a project sets up is taken and warned of, never refused, so each warning goes to the person. Run it after every change, and check before you describe: before telling the person how value moves (a burn, a free token, a swap, a refund, a payment held or not), check one draft with that mechanism once and read what it says (one draft, not every variant). Quote every count of approvals from it. Give the spec inline (`spec`), a file, or an example.

example.description: A worked example by name, from xsolana_examples (coin-flip-arena, stud-farm, …).

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_check
